mostWorthwhile.text: Lifting and holding the glass was the most worthwhile action: it connected the repair sequence to the body's continuing work, including muscle tension during stillness.

leastWorthwhile.text: The collagen-building sequence became predictable, with several consecutive combinations advancing one process. The explanations were useful, but the choices felt repetitive.

surprise.text: The renewed surface may retain a scar while deeper rebuilding continues; it is not an instant return to the original tissue.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly purposeless. The fiber-forming helpers were somewhat vague, though their result explained their role outside the cell.

continue.text: I would probably not continue immediately. The final connection to holding the glass was satisfying and the biology was clear, but the predictable sequence offered few meaningful choices.
